plan_definitions.unit: Django TestCase for models, forms and views of each module
plan_definitions.integration: views ↔ ORM ↔ MySQL, for example allocation transaction and constraints
plan_definitions.system: end-to-end flows from the browser using the test cases in Section 13

rules: Classify every discovered source method by its full asserted behavior, not class name, TestCase base, HTTP usage or existence of ORM fixtures.
Component units may directly validate models/forms/helpers or one coherent module view contract using persistent fixtures; fixture service calls alone do not establish integration.
Actual SQL constraint assertions, multi-component persisted workflows, transaction/rollback coordination, auditing integration and relational business-state reconciliation are integration.

Room plus owned Bed synchronization is treated as one hostels model component; allocation plus student/hostel-bed invariants are cross-module integration, with the plan's alternative model-unit reading explicitly flagged.
Never split a mixed method's covered lines into unit attribution without a separate method: any explicit database-constraint or multi-component workflow assertion governs that method.
Parallel DB operations are concurrency; cross-module route smoke/journey methods are system-level test-client surrogates, not evidence of actual browser execution.
Verification runner tests and static deployment configuration checks are tooling/configuration, outside application-unit numerator.

Conservative unit subset includes only primary component-unit methods with borderline=false. Sensitivity subset additionally includes all explicitly plausible borderline unit candidates, without claiming QA acceptance.
No coverage percentage or target was used to choose or revise classifications. Identity comparison to prior JUnit is provenance only, not current execution evidence.

prior_junit_identity_comparison.note: Prior JUnit establishes historical identities only; it does not establish current 190-method execution or statuses.
